metric_semantics.reward_mean: Training rollout mean; not held-out validation accuracy. All 50 recorded reward means equal raw score means.

metric_semantics.actor_grad_norm: Logged aggregation over optimizer minibatches; not a per-update trace.
metric_semantics.step_alignment: Rollout rewards describe samples collected before that rollout training update; step is not optimizer-update count.

metric_definitions.historical_exact_source_note: Historical c423 commit is unavailable. Source references are the verified current local official checkout; token/throughput/time-normalization formulas below independently match all50 original logged rows.
metric_definitions.perf/total_num_tokens: Sum of valid attention-mask tokens over2048 sampled sequences, prompt plus response; repeated prompts count for every sampled response.
metric_definitions.perf/throughput: total_num_tokens / timing_s/step /4 GPUs; input+output tokens per second per GPU, not generation-only throughput.
metric_definitions.perf/time_per_step: Identical to timing_s/step in all50 rows.
metric_definitions.timing_per_token_ms/gen: 1000*timing_s/gen / sum generated response tokens; whole-run denominator, not per GPU.
metric_definitions.timing_per_token_ms/ref_adv_update_actor: 1000*phase_seconds / sum(prompt+response) tokens; update_actor covers the configured PPO update phase, including4 expected optimizer minibatches.
metric_definitions.actor/perf/max_memory_allocated_gb: CUDA allocator peak allocated bytes /2**30, GiB despite field name.
metric_definitions.actor/perf/max_memory_reserved_gb: CUDA allocator peak reserved bytes /2**30; allocator high-water mark, not current live allocation.
metric_definitions.actor/perf/cpu_memory_used_gb: psutil.virtual_memory().used /2**30 in the referenced implementation; host-visible used memory, not individual actor RSS.
metric_definitions.phase_partition: Recorded phase timers need not exhaust the full step timer; uninstrumented or overlapping work must not be assigned to a phase without additional evidence.
